SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` LIKE '%High%'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800

SELECT f.CDSCode,
       f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND sc.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'

SELECT s.School, s.MailStreet
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'borderless'
  AND NOT (cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL)

FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL)
  AND l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'

       c.name,
       r.date,
       r.text AS ruling_text,
       CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_missing_or_degraded_properties
FROM cards AS c
JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid

SELECT borderColor FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

SELECT l.format, l.status
FROM legalities AS l
JOIN cards AS c ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Benalish Knight'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN borderColor = 'borderless' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) AS borderless_percentage
FROM cards

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN c.id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.id) AS french_percentage
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE originalType = 'Summon - Angel'
  AND subtypes <> 'Angel'
SELECT id FROM cards WHERE duelDeck = 'a'

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
WHERE c.originalType = 'Artifact'
  AND c.colors = 'B'

SELECT manaCost
FROM cards
WHERE layout = 'normal'
  AND frameVersion = '2003'
  AND borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability = 'mtgo,paper'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM set_translations AS st
JOIN sets AS s ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Commander'
  AND st.language = 'Portuguese (Brasil)'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'premodern'
  AND r.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.'
  AND c.side IS NULL

SELECT fd.name
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE fd.language = 'French'
  AND c.type = 'Creature'
  AND c.layout = 'normal'
  AND c.borderColor = 'black'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN c.uuid END) AS REAL) * 100
       / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS french_percentage
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 AND layout = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(isTextless) AS proportion FROM cards

SELECT DISTINCT st.translation
FROM cards c
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
  AND st.language = 'Italian'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Adam Rex'
  AND setCode IN (
      SELECT setCode
      FROM set_translations
      WHERE translation = 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition'
  )

SELECT st.translation
FROM set_translations st
JOIN sets s ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Eighth Edition'
  AND st.language = 'Chinese Simplified'

SELECT DISTINCT s.code,
       s.name,
       CASE WHEN s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS appeared_on_mtgo
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy'

SELECT fd.text
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.convertedManaCost = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.convertedManaCost) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(p.Id) AS PostCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

SELECT COUNT(p.Id)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Age > 65
  AND p.Score >= 20

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = 24) * 1.0
       / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = 24) AS PostToVoteRatio

SELECT u.DisplayName, u.Reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing?'

SELECT c.*
FROM comments c
WHERE c.UserId IN (
    SELECT ph.UserId
    FROM postHistory ph
    JOIN posts p ON p.Id = ph.PostId
    WHERE p.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
      AND ph.UserId IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT p.LastEditorUserId
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
      AND p.LastEditorUserId IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT AVG(p.ViewCount) AS AverageViewCount,
       p.Title,
       c.Text AS Comment
FROM posts AS p
JOIN comments AS c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<humor>%'
GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title, c.Text

SELECT p.Id
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'slashnick'
ORDER BY p.AnswerCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS comment_count
FROM comments
WHERE PostId = (
    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    ORDER BY Score DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT c.Text, c.UserDisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT ExcerptPostId, WikiPostId
FROM tags
WHERE TagName = 'sample'

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments AS c
JOIN posts AS p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150
ORDER BY c.Score DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(y.Consumption) / 12.0 AS average_monthly_consumption
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_difference
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'

SELECT substr(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Year
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY substr(y.Date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH cust AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, total,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total ASC) AS rk
    FROM cust
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT Segment, AVG(total) AS avg_total
    FROM mins
    WHERE rk = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_total FROM ranked WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT avg_total FROM ranked WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_total FROM ranked WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT avg_total FROM ranked WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_total FROM ranked WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT avg_total FROM ranked WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'CZE' AND Segment = 'Discount' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'Discount' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS more_discount_gas_stations
FROM gasstations

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'

SELECT MAX(Consumption) AS highest_monthly_consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN products AS p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE substr(t.Date, 1, 7) = '2013-09'

SELECT DISTINCT t.Time
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.ChainID = 11

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) AS REAL) * 100.0
       / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS EUR_Customer_Percentage
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'

SELECT
    SUM(Price) AS total_spent,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', Date) = '2012-01' THEN Price ELSE 0 END) AS january_2012_spent
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE CustomerID = 38508

SELECT DISTINCT y.CustomerID, y.Consumption
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN yearmonth y
  ON y.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
 AND y.Date = '201208'
WHERE t.ProductID = 5
  AND t.Price / t.Amount > 29.00

SELECT L.name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT L.name, COUNT(M.id) AS match_count
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
        AND buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(pa.id) AS left_foot_percentage
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE CAST(substr(p.birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992

SELECT CAST(SUM(pa.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
   OR p.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(pa.finishing) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada')
ORDER BY birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT p.player_name,
           pa.overall_rating,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_name ORDER BY pa.date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
)
SELECT (a.overall_rating - b.overall_rating) * 100.0 / b.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM latest a
JOIN latest b ON b.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' AND b.rn = 1
WHERE a.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' AND a.rn = 1

SELECT ta.chanceCreationPassing, ta.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Ajax'
ORDER BY ta.chanceCreationPassing DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77
  AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2016-02-04%'

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN Team AS t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient'
  AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high'

SELECT
  (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6)
  - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
  AND potential IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC
LIMIT 4

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'

SELECT l.name, COUNT(m.id) AS game_count
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY game_count DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, dist.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.account_id, l.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND a2.date LIKE '1993%'
  )

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp di ON di.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = di.client_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND di.type = 'OWNER'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000

SELECT d.A2
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
ORDER BY t.amount DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'

SELECT q.q1
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Bruno' AND d.surname = 'Senna'
  AND q.raceId = 354

SELECT DISTINCT d.url
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE lt.raceId = 161
  AND lt.time LIKE '1:27%'

SELECT s.url
FROM races r
JOIN seasons s ON s.year = r.year
WHERE r.raceId = 901

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.raceId = 872
  AND r.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.dob DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(COUNT(r.time) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(r.driverId) AS completion_rate
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.date = '1983-07-16'

SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS average_lap_time
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN drivers AS d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
  AND r.year = 2009

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER) AS age,
       forename || ' ' || surname AS name
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND dob IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY dob DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT r.name, r.year
FROM results res
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Alex' AND d.surname = 'Yoong'
  AND res.position < 20

SELECT r.name AS race_name, r.year
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Michael' AND d.surname = 'Schumacher'
  AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2007
  AND r.position = 1

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS race_completion_percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

SELECT AVG(CAST(r2.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_speed
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS r2 ON r2.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
  AND r.year = 2009
  AND NULLIF(r2.fastestLapSpeed, '') IS NOT NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) < 1985 AND r.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
       / COUNT(r.driverId) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005

WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT number, nationality
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT number,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM top3 WHERE nationality IN ('Dutch', 'Netherlandic')) AS dutch_count
FROM top3

SELECT driverRef
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'German' AND dob IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY dob ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.code
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE strftime('%Y', d.dob) = '1971'
  AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
       AVG(p.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_duration_ms
FROM pitStops p
JOIN drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY avg_pitstop_duration_ms ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS champion,
       r.time AS finish_time
FROM races ra
JOIN results r ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2008
  AND r.positionOrder = 1

SELECT SUM(r.points) AS score, c.name, c.nationality
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accidents
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.statusId = 3
GROUP BY r.driverId
ORDER BY accidents DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name AS circuit,
       MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS lap_record_ms
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
    GROUP BY e.event_id
    HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 10
) AS meeting_events

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
          AND SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(x.approved) = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 0
         THEN 'Yes'
         ELSE 'No'
       END AS all_approved
FROM expense x
JOIN budget b ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event v ON b.link_to_event = v.event_id
WHERE v.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND v.event_date = '2019-10-08'

SELECT b.event_status
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters'

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, t.trans_id, t.date, t.amount, t.operation, t.k_symbol FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%' ORDER BY t.amount DESC LIMIT 10

WITH f AS (SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, t.A11, d.account_id FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN district t ON c.district_id = t.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F') SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM f WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM f) AND A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM f WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM f))
SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
SELECT c.lat, c.lng FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'
SELECT q.q1 FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Bruno' AND d.surname = 'Senna' AND q.raceId = 354
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url, l.lap, l.time FROM lapTimes l JOIN drivers d ON l.driverId = d.driverId WHERE l.raceId = 161 AND l.time LIKE '1:27%'
SELECT s.url FROM races r JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.raceId = 901

SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 872 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND r.time <> '' AND d.dob = (SELECT MAX(d2.dob) FROM results r2 JOIN drivers d2 ON r2.driverId = d2.driverId WHERE r2.raceId = 872 AND r2.time IS NOT NULL AND r2.time <> '')

SELECT COUNT(r.driverId) AS total_drivers, COUNT(r.time) AS completed_drivers, CAST(COUNT(r.time) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.driverId) AS completion_rate_pct FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.date = '1983-07-16'

SELECT AVG(lapTimes.milliseconds) AS average_lap_time_ms FROM lapTimes JOIN drivers ON lapTimes.driverId = drivers.driverId JOIN races ON lapTimes.raceId = races.raceId WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' AND races.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix' AND races.year = 2009
SELECT forename, surname, dob, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(dob)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' AND dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT r.raceId, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.date, res.position FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Alex' AND d.surname = 'Yoong' AND res.position < 20 ORDER BY r.date

SELECT races.name, races.year, lapTimes.milliseconds FROM lapTimes JOIN drivers ON lapTimes.driverId = drivers.driverId JOIN races ON lapTimes.raceId = races.raceId WHERE drivers.forename = 'Michael' AND drivers.surname = 'Schumacher' AND lapTimes.milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lapTimes.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.driverRef FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007 AND r.positionOrder = 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS completion_percentage FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

SELECT AVG(CAST(r2.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_speed FROM results r2 JOIN races ra ON r2.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2009 AND r2.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) < 1985 AND r.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numerator_count, COUNT(*) AS denominator_count FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
SELECT COUNT(*) AS netherlandic_count FROM (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL AND nationality = 'Dutch' ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 3)
SELECT driverRef FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' AND dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.code FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE strftime('%Y', d.dob) = '1971' AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND r.fastestLapTime <> ''

SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, AVG(CAST(p.duration AS REAL)) AS avg_pit_duration FROM pitStops p JOIN drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985 AND p.duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob ORDER BY avg_pit_duration ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.time, r.milliseconds FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.positionOrder = 1

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.driverId, COUNT(*) AS accidents FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.statusId = 3 GROUP BY r.driverId ORDER BY accidents DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name AS circuit, c.location, c.country, lt.time AS lap_record_time, lt.milliseconds, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId WHERE c.country = 'Italy' AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(lt2.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes lt2 JOIN races r2 ON lt2.raceId = r2.raceId WHERE r2.circuitId = c.circuitId AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY c.name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_count FROM (SELECT a.link_to_event FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Meeting' GROUP BY a.link_to_event HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 10) AS sub

SELECT e.expense_id, e.expense_description, e.expense_date, e.cost, e.approved FROM expense e JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND ev.event_date LIKE '2019-10-08%'
SELECT b.event_status FROM expense e JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE e.expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' AND e.expense_date = '2019-8-20'
SELECT major.major_name FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE member.first_name = 'Brent' AND member.last_name = 'Thomason'
SELECT major.department FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE member.position = 'President'

SELECT e.event_name, b.spent, b.amount, CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / b.amount AS spend_to_budget_ratio FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.status = 'Closed' AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 ORDER BY spend_to_budget_ratio DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT link_to_event, MAX(spent) AS highest_spent FROM budget
SELECT SUM(spent) AS total_spent_food FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food'
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM member m JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_event) > 7
SELECT source, amount FROM income WHERE date_received BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-09-30' ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT b.category, b.amount, SUM(b.amount) OVER () AS total_budgeted FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker' ORDER BY b.amount ASC

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost FROM member m LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE m.member_id = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v' GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
SELECT DISTINCT type FROM event WHERE location = 'MU 215'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i.amount = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount_50_count, COUNT(m.member_id) AS medium_member_count FROM member m LEFT JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id AND i.source = 'Student_Club' WHERE m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium' AND m.position = 'Member'
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.cost FROM expense e JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'
SELECT sp.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'

SELECT p.publisher_name, s.superhero_name, ha.attribute_value FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_heroes, SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_heroes, SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_marvel_heroes FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL

SELECT s.superhero_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'durability' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics' ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count FROM hero_power hp JOIN superhero s ON hp.hero_id = s.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Amazo'
SELECT superhero.superhero_name, superhero.height_cm FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS hero_count FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute ha2 JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength')
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Brown'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN eye_colour_id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS blue_eye_count, COUNT(superhero_name) AS total_superheroes FROM superhero
SELECT g.gender, COUNT(s.id) AS hero_count FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY g.gender
SELECT p.ID, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS Age FROM Patient p WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT e.ID FROM Examination e WHERE e.RVVT = '+')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_abnormal_ua, SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_abnormal_ua FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.UA IS NOT NULL

SELECT L.ID, L.HGB, E.`Examination Date`, P.Birthday, CAST(strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_exam, E.Diagnosis FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID LEFT JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = L.ID AND E.`Examination Date` = L.Date WHERE L.HGB IS NOT NULL ORDER BY L.HGB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(L.ALB) AS avg_albumin FROM Laboratory L INNER JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.PLT > 400 AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.Date, l.UA, CASE WHEN (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5) THEN 'Above normal' ELSE 'Within normal' END AS UA_Status FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.ID = 57266 AND l.UA IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.Date
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.GPT >= 60

SELECT p.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.HCT >= 52 GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday HAVING COUNT(l.ID) >= 2

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, l.Date, l.PLT FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1984' AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 50 AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_patients_abnormal_fg FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.WBC > 3.5 AND l.WBC < 9.0 AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CRP = '+' AND p.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND p.SEX = 'F' AND e.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule m WHERE m.label = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND LOWER(a.element) = 'f')) AS carcinogenic_without_fluorine, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule m WHERE m.label = '+') AS total_carcinogenic
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT element FROM (SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' AND element IS NOT NULL GROUP BY element ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3) ORDER BY element ASC
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT atom_id, COUNT(bond_id) AS connections FROM connected WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19' GROUP BY atom_id
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR004'
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 21 AND 25 AND m.label = '+'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS total_atoms FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-')
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS chlorine_percentage FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' GROUP BY m.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5
